basic_profile.bio: Steve is a 24-year-old software developer from Seattle who recently joined Reddit to connect with other gaming enthusiasts. He has a passion for sandbox and survival games, with Minecraft being his latest obsession. When he's not gaming, Steve enjoys reading manga, particularly 'Vinland Saga', and is fascinated by psychological thrillers like 'Sharp Objects'. He often browses Reddit in the evenings after work, usually around 7 PM to midnight. Steve is currently single and enjoys spending his weekends exploring local aquariums and learning about marine life.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Steve has a degree in Computer Science and has been working in the tech industry for two years. He is mostly self-taught when it comes to gaming and hardware setups, having learned through trial and error and online tutorials. His interest in marine biology is purely a hobby, inspired by his frequent visits to aquariums.
